title: Gamemode
description: The gamemode module displays if any game or application is running with Feral Gamemode optimizations.

placeholders.description: The string icon glyph to use instead.
The number of games running with gamemode optimizations.

format.label: What to show
format.description: The text shown in the bar. Words in curly braces, like {icon}, are replaced with live values: see the list of placeholders.

format-alt.label: What to show after a click
format-alt.description: Clicking the module switches to this text. Click again to go back.

tooltip.label: Show tooltip
tooltip.doc: Option to disable tooltip on hover.
tooltip.description: Show a small popup with more details when the mouse is over the module.

tooltip-format.label: Tooltip text
tooltip-format.doc: The text format of the tooltip.
tooltip-format.description: What the popup shows. It uses the same placeholders as the bar text.

hide-not-running.label: Hide not running
hide-not-running.doc: Defines if the module should be hidden if no games are running.
hide-not-running.description: Defines if the module should be hidden if no games are running.

use-icon.label: Use icon
use-icon.doc: Defines if the module should display a GTK icon instead of the specified glyph
use-icon.description: Defines if the module should display a GTK icon instead of the specified glyph

glyph.label: Glyph
glyph.doc: The string icon to display. Only visible if use-icon is set to false.
glyph.description: The string icon to display. Only visible if use-icon is set to false.

icon-name.label: Icon name
icon-name.doc: The GTK icon to display. Only visible if use-icon is set to true.
icon-name.description: The GTK icon to display. Only visible if use-icon is set to true.

icon-size.label: Icon size
icon-size.doc: Defines the size of the icons. Set to 0 for auto size.
icon-size.description: Defines the size of the icons. Set to 0 for auto size.

icon-spacing.label: Icon spacing
icon-spacing.doc: Defines the spacing between the icon and the text.
icon-spacing.description: Defines the spacing between the icon and the text.

expand.label: Fill empty space
expand.doc: Enables this module to consume all left over space dynamically.
expand.description: Stretch the module to use all the free space left in its section.
